_about: Game powers the emulator keeps under another buff. Read by tools/fidelity/fight_compare.py (comparing) and tools/emudump/Reanchor.cs (writing the game's powers back), so both directions use one table. Keys are power keys: the game's power id, or the emulator's BuffId name, in UPPER_SNAKE without _POWER.
_folds: Game powers the emulator holds in one buff, the summed amounts as they stand. Every subclass of the game's TemporaryStrengthPower (TemporaryDexterityPower, TemporaryFocusPower) is one emulator buff, and the owner sets the direction. SelfFormingClayPower pays unpowered block after the next block clear, as BlockNextTurnPower does, so the emulator holds both in BLOCK_NEXT_TURN: a game BLOCK_NEXT_TURN beside a folded power joins their sum (fight_compare.game_powers, Reanchor.PatchBuffs).
